scope: source-only diagnostic instrumentation; prior native evidence is not transferred

edits.after:
run: |
          export NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-} --import=file://$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tools/support/ci/cargo-metadata-observer.ts?capture=$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-plugin-cargo-metadata"
          vp run --filter './npm/native' build:ci

- name: Validate complete Cargo metadata capture packets
        if: always()
        run: vp node tools/support/ci/cargo-metadata-observer.ts --validate-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/typescript-plugin-cargo-metadata"
      - name: Preserve actual Cargo metadata child streams and exit state
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: typescript-plugin-cargo-metadata-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/typescript-plugin-cargo-metadata
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
